video:video.video:title: Viking History for Sleep 🌙 A Quiet Night of Longships & Fjords
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story through the Viking Age, from Scandinavian farms, fjords and the first longships to the Danelaw, the Rus river roads, Iceland and Greenland.

video:video.video:title: Halloween Sleep Story for Adults 🌙 Samhain, the Celtic Origins
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm sleep story about Samhain, the old Gaelic festival at summer's end, and the long road that turned it into Halloween. No horror, just quiet history at dusk.

video:video.video:title: A Calm Night on the Nile 🌙 Ancient Egypt Sleep Story
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story along the Nile, from the first farmers on the floodplain to the pyramids of Giza, the temples of Thebes and Cleopatra's Alexandria.

video:video.video:title: Ancient Greece History for Sleep 🌙 From Crete to Alexander
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story through ancient Greece, from the palaces of Crete and Mycenae through Sparta, Athens and the Persian Wars to Alexander and the Hellenistic world.

video:video.video:title: Feudal Japan History for Sleep 🌙 A Quiet Samurai Sleep Story
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story through feudal Japan, from the Heian court and the first samurai through the Kamakura shogunate and the three unifiers to the Tokugawa peace and the Meiji Restoration.

video:video.video:title: Silk Road Sleep Story 🌙 Drift Through Ancient Asia by Caravan
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story along the Silk Road, from a silkworm in ancient China to the oasis kingdoms, the Heavenly Mountains of Central Asia and the blue domes of Samarkand.

video:video.video:title: A Quiet Night in Constantinople 🌙 Calming Byzantine History for Sleep
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, nearly hour-long sleep story through Byzantium and its great city of Constantinople, from a Greek colony on the Bosphorus through Justinian, Hagia Sophia and the Basilica Cistern to the city's last chapter in 1453.

video:video.video:title: Moonlight over Ur and Babylon 🌙 A Calming Mesopotamia Sleep Story
video:video.video:description: A slow, calm, hour-long sleep story about the evenings of ancient Mesopotamia, from sunset on the roofs of Ur and the three watches of the night to clay lamps, beer through straws, lullabies, dreams and the star-watchers of Babylon.

video:video.video:title: A Candlelit Day of the Dead 🌙 Calming Día de los Muertos Sleep Story
video:video.video:description: A calm two-hour Day of the Dead sleep story for adults: Mexica roots, All Souls, sugar skulls, La Catrina and Mixquic's candles. Chapters, no ad breaks.

video:video.video:title: Medieval Halloween: Soul Cakes and Bells | History for Sleep
video:video.video:description: Medieval Halloween history for sleep: a calm, two-hour night on All Hallows' Eve in a late-medieval English village, with soul cakes, souling, and church bells rung all night for the souls of the dead.

video:video.video:title: Ice Age History for Sleep 🌙 How Did Ancient Humans Sleep?
video:video.video:description: How did ancient humans sleep? A bedtime story for grown-ups in calming history narration: relaxing bedtime history from one long Ice Age night.
